messages:
Zoe: heads up 1 95f1 meet Pickle the hedgehog 9ad 34e just woke up from a burrito nap on my sweater. posted: pickle_burrito.jpg
Omar: he looks like a tiny, prickly burrito of joy :joy: absolute content king
Casey: 10/10 would pet through a tiny sweater. is hedgehog snoring audible or stealth mode?
Zoe: full-on squeaky snore if you poke gently. vet says supervised cuddles only.
Jun: caption contest: "pickled and committed to naps" :tada:
Marley: adding to my wallpaper rotation. also, hedgehog care tip request: any snacks that are safe?
Zoe: plain high-protein hedgehog food, mealworms as treats. no grapes.
Omar: ops-bot quick policy q: can we do a "bring a pet for 1 hour" day? Pickle is small and quiet.
ops-bot: Reminder: Pet visits require People Ops approval. Non-mammals and small critters require carrier transit and prior sign-off. Please submit Pet Visit request at least 72 hours in advance and include an allergy check.
Zoe: will file the form. low-key thought: hedgehog cameo in next team retro for morale? virtual cameo works too.
Casey: would attend retro solely to see Pickle do a mic cameo :raised_hands: :grin:
Jun: poll: virtual cameo / lobby hello / desk cameo (react 1/2/3). also any good GitHub handle ideas for Pickle? :thinking:
Omar: suggestions: @pickleddev / @tiny-burrito / @quip-hedge
Zoe: love @tiny-burrito. thanks team for the warm welcome to Pickle :)
